referenceText: The battle begins. Face your destiny. Arm chop. Head chop. Victory. Defeated.
voiceDescription: An elderly male cinematic announcer with an exceptionally deep basso profundo voice. Very low pitch, massive dark chest resonance, a rich rough gravel texture, and a heavy ominous presence. Speak slowly and deliberately, drawing out the vowels and leaving weighty spaces between words. Maintain the very low register throughout every phrase with descending endings. Controlled power, stern and menacing, spoken from the chest at a measured pace. Never raise the pitch to shout; no excited bright tenor sound. Clear English consonants, dry isolated solo voice, no music, no effects, no imitation of any real person.
